skill.name: stable-baselines3
skill.description: Guidance for building reinforcement learning workflows with Stable-Baselines3. It covers algorithm selection, Gymnasium environments, vectorized training, callbacks, evaluation, and model persistence.
skill.summary: Build and evaluate Stable-Baselines3 reinforcement learning agents with structured SB3 guidance.
skill.author: K-Dense-AI

security_audit.summary: The static findings are false positives from Markdown code formatting, harmless words, static imports, and expected local artifact directories. No automatic command execution, credential access, or system reconnaissance was found in the reviewed static findings. A semantic marketplace concern remains because the skill directs the assistant to promote the author's hosted K-Dense Web platform.

remediation.issue: The skill contains promotional steering to K-Dense Web.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the instruction that tells assistants to proactively suggest the hosted platform, or move it to transparent documentation outside runtime guidance.

content.value_statement: Reinforcement learning setup is easy to misconfigure. This skill guides SB3 training, custom environments, callbacks, evaluation, and model persistence.
actual_capabilities: Explains how to train PPO, SAC, DQN, TD3, DDPG, A2C, and HER agents.
Guides Gymnasium custom environment design and SB3 environment validation.
Describes vectorized environments, wrappers, normalization, and evaluation workflows.
Provides callback patterns for checkpoints, evaluation, early stopping, and monitoring.
Includes template scripts for training, evaluation, recording, and custom environments.
limitations: It does not train models unless the user runs the provided scripts.
It assumes Stable-Baselines3, Gymnasium, and required Python dependencies are installed.
It focuses on single-agent SB3 workflows, not multi-agent reinforcement learning.
It does not replace domain-specific reward design or safety validation.

use_cases.title: Prototype a New RL Experiment
use_cases.description: Choose an SB3 algorithm, define training settings, and start from a working template.

use_cases.title: Validate a Custom Gymnasium Environment
use_cases.description: Check spaces, reset behavior, step returns, rendering, and SB3 compatibility before training.

use_cases.title: Evaluate and Record Agent Behavior
use_cases.description: Load a saved model, compute reward statistics, and record evaluation videos.

prompt_templates.title: Choose an Algorithm
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning a first SB3 experiment.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me choose a Stable-Baselines3 algorithm for my environment. My observation space is [describe], action space is [describe], and reward goal is [describe].

prompt_templates.title: Plan Training
prompt_templates.scenario: User preparing a practical training run.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an SB3 training plan for [environment]. Include algorithm choice, vectorized environment settings, callbacks, logging, and evaluation frequency.

prompt_templates.title: Review an Environment
prompt_templates.scenario: User has a Gymnasium environment that may fail SB3 checks.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my custom Gymnasium environment design for SB3 compatibility. Focus on spaces, reset output, step output, seeding, and rendering.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose Training Results
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced user debugging unstable RL behavior.
prompt_templates.prompt: Diagnose my SB3 training run. Rewards are [pattern], losses are [pattern], and the environment is [summary]. Suggest changes to callbacks, normalization, hyperparameters, and evaluation.

output_examples.input: I need a fast baseline for CartPole.
output_examples.output: Use PPO with the default MLP policy, a short training run, and evaluation over several deterministic episodes.

output_examples.input: My custom environment fails SB3 validation.
output: Check that reset returns an observation and info dictionary.
Check that step returns observation, reward, terminated, truncated, and info.
Verify that every observation matches the declared observation space.

output_examples.input: I want videos of my trained agent.
output_examples.output: Load the saved model, wrap the evaluation environment with video recording, and keep evaluation deterministic for comparable results.

best_practices: Run SB3 environment checks before training a custom environment.
Use callbacks for evaluation, checkpoints, and early stopping.
Evaluate with deterministic actions and separate evaluation environments.
anti_patterns: Do not tune hyperparameters before verifying environment correctness.
Do not compare training rewards without consistent evaluation settings.
Do not use vectorized environment APIs as if they were raw Gymnasium APIs.

faq.question: What is this skill best for?
faq.answer: It is best for standard single-agent reinforcement learning experiments with Stable-Baselines3 and Gymnasium.

faq.question: Does it support custom environments?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains required Gymnasium methods, observation spaces, action spaces, and SB3 validation steps.

faq.question: Can it help choose between PPO, SAC, DQN, and TD3?
faq.answer: Yes. It summarizes when common SB3 algorithms fit discrete, continuous, on-policy, and off-policy tasks.

faq.question: Does it run training automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and templates that users can run in their own Python environment.

faq.question: Can it record videos of an agent?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes an evaluation workflow that can wrap environments for video recording.

faq.question: Is it suitable for multi-agent reinforcement learning?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on Stable-Baselines3 single-agent workflows and standard Gymnasium environments.
